standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.npc: Hi there. So much to see here!

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.player: Yep, could be looking all day!

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.npc: Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.player: Sounds fun, how did you do that?

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.npc: Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.player: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.npc: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-1.player: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-2.player: Hello, what are you doing here?

standard-dialogue-dialogue-2.npc: Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-2.player: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!

standard-dialogue-dialogue-2.npc: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-3.npc: Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-3.player: Okay, I'll let you get on then.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-3.npc: Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.npc: Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.player: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.npc: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.player: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.npc: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.player: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.npc: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.player: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.

standard-dialogue-dialogue-4.npc: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!

if-the-player-hasn-t-completed-the-dig-s.player: Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?

if-the-player-hasn-t-completed-the-dig-s.npc: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!

if-the-player-hasn-t-completed-the-dig-s.player: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
